MATHIEU FUNCTIONS (p.737)
20.7.21  ce_r(z,q)=\sigma_r\int_0^{\pi/2}\cosh(2\sqrt q\sin z\sin t)[(1-p)+p\cos z\cos t]\,ce_r(t,q)\,dt
20.7.22  se_r(z,q)=\rho_r\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin\big(2\sqrt q\cos z\cos t+p\tfrac{\pi}{2}\big)\sin z\sin t\,se_r(t,q)\,dt
20.7.23  se_r(z,q)=\sigma_r\int_0^{\pi/2}\sinh(2\sqrt q\sin z\sin t)[(1-p)\cos z\cos t+p]\,se_r(t,q)\,dt
where
20.7.24  \rho_r=\dfrac{2}{\pi}ce_{2s}\big(\tfrac{\pi}{2},q\big)/A_0^{2s}(q);\ p=0 \qquad \rho_r=\dfrac{-2}{\pi}ce'_{2s+1}\big(\tfrac{\pi}{2},q\big)/\sqrt q\,A_1^{2s+1}(q)\text{ if }p=1,\text{ for functions }ce_r(z,q)
\rho_r=\dfrac{-4}{\pi}se'_{2s}\big(\tfrac{\pi}{2},q\big)/\sqrt q\,B_2^{2s}(q);\ \rho_r=\dfrac{4}{\pi}se_{2s+1}\big(\tfrac{\pi}{2},q\big)/B_1^{2s+1}(q),\text{ for functions }se_r(z,q)
\sigma_r=\dfrac{2}{\pi}ce_{2s}(0,q)/A_0^{2s}(q)\text{ if }p=0;\qquad \sigma_r=\dfrac{4}{\pi}ce_{2s+1}(0,q)/A_1^{2s+1}(q),\text{ if }p=1;\text{ associated with functions }ce_r(z,q)
\sigma_r=\dfrac{4}{\pi}se'_{2s}(0,q)/\sqrt q\,B_2^{2s}(q),\text{ if }p=0;\qquad \sigma_r=\dfrac{2}{\pi}se'_{2s+1}(0,q)/\sqrt q\,B_1^{2s+1}(q),\text{ if }p=1;\text{ associated with }se_r(z,q)
Integrals Involving Bessel Function Kernels
Let
20.7.25  u=\sqrt{2q(\cosh2z+\cos2t)},\ (\Re\cosh2z>1;\text{ if }j=1,\text{ valid also when }z=0)
20.7.26  Mc_{2r}^{(j)}(z,q)=\dfrac{(-1)^r2}{\pi A_0^{2r}}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}Z_0^{(j)}(u)\,ce_{2r}(t,q)\,dt\ ;\ Mc_{2r+1}^{(j)}(z,q)=\dfrac{(-1)^r8\sqrt q\cosh z}{\pi A_1^{2r+1}}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\dfrac{Z_1^{(j)}(u)\cos t}{u}\,ce_{2r+1}(t,q)\,dt
20.7.27  Ms_{2r}^{(j)}(z,q)=\dfrac{(-1)^{r+1}8q\sinh2z}{\pi B_2^{2r}}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\dfrac{Z_2^{(j)}(u)\sin2t}{u^2}\,se_{2r}(t,q)\,dt
Ms_{2r+1}^{(j)}(z,q)=\dfrac{(-1)^r8\sqrt q\sinh z}{\pi B_1^{2r+1}}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\dfrac{Z_1^{(j)}(u)\sin t}{u}\,se_{2r+1}(t,q)\,dt
In the above the j-convention of 20.4.7 applies and the functions Mc, Ms are defined in 20.5.1-20.5.4. (These solutions are normalized so that they approach the corresponding Bessel-Hankel functions as \Re z\to\infty.)
Other Integrals for Mc_r^{(1)}(z,q) and Ms_r^{(1)}(z,q)
20.7.28  Mc_r^{(1)}(z,q)=\dfrac{(-1)^s2}{\pi\,ce_r(0,q)}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\cos\big(2\sqrt q\cosh z\cos t-p\tfrac\pi2\big)\,ce_r(t,q)\,dt
20.7.29  Mc_r^{(1)}(z,q)=\tau_r\int_0^{\frac\pi2}[(1-p)+p\cosh z\cos t]\cos(2\sqrt q\sinh z\sin t)\,ce_r(t,q)\,dt
r=2s+p,\ p=0,1;\ \tau_r=\dfrac2\pi(-1)^s/ce_{2s}\big(\tfrac\pi2,q\big),\text{ if }p=0;\ \tau_r=\dfrac2\pi(-1)^{s+1}2\sqrt q/ce'_{2s+1}\big(\tfrac\pi2,q\big)
20.7.30  Ms_{2r+1}^{(1)}(z,q)=\dfrac2\pi\dfrac{(-1)^r}{se_{2r+1}\left(\frac\pi2,q\right)}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\sin(2\sqrt q\sinh z\sin t)\,se_{2r+1}(t,q)\,dt
20.7.31  Ms_{2r+1}^{(1)}(z,q)=\dfrac4\pi\dfrac{\sqrt q(-1)^r}{se'_{2r+1}(0,q)}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\sinh z\sin t\cos(2\sqrt q\cosh z\cos t)\,se_{2r+1}(t,q)\,dt
20.7.32  Ms_{2r}^{(1)}(z,q)=\dfrac4\pi\sqrt q\,\dfrac{(-1)^{r+1}}{se'_{2r}(0,q)}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\sin(2\sqrt q\cosh z\cos t)\,[\sinh z\sin t\,se_{2r}(t,q)]\,dt
20.7.33  Ms_{2r}^{(1)}(z,q)=\dfrac4\pi\dfrac{(-1)^r\sqrt q}{se'_{2r}\left(\frac\pi2,q\right)}\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\sin(2\sqrt q\sinh z\sin t)[\cosh z\cos t\,se_{2r}(t,q)]\,dt
